elements.name: create
elements.brief: Parses a compiled ink story and returns a story instance.
elements.description: Parses a compiled ink story and returns a story instance.

parameters.name: s
parameters.doc: The ink JSON text, for example from `sys.load_resource`. It must be UTF-8.

properties.name: variables
properties.brief: A table of all global variables, to read and set. Use `assign_value` to notify
properties.description:
A table of all global variables, to read and set. Use `assign_value` to notify
observer functions about a change.

properties.name: continue
properties.brief: Returns the next paragraphs and choices.
properties.description: Returns the next paragraphs and choices.

properties.name: add_observer
properties.brief: Assigns an observer function to a global variable. Each global variable can have
properties.description:
Assigns an observer function to a global variable. Each global variable can have
multiple observers.
types: (name: string, f: (this: void, value: unknown) => void) => void

properties.name: remove_observer
types: (name: string, f?: (this: void, value: unknown) => void) => void

properties.name: assign_value
properties.brief: Assigns a value to a global variable and calls all its observers.
properties.description: Assigns a value to a global variable and calls all its observers.

properties.name: bind
properties.brief: Binds a Lua function to an ink external function, which the story then calls
properties.description:
Binds a Lua function to an ink external function, which the story then calls
with the external function's arguments.
types: (name: string, f: (this: void, ...args: any[]) => unknown) => void

properties.name: jump
properties.brief: Jumps to a named knot or stitch, and returns its paragraphs and choices.
properties.description: Jumps to a named knot or stitch, and returns its paragraphs and choices.

properties.name: switch_flow
properties.brief: Creates a new parallel flow or switches to an existing one.
properties.description: Creates a new parallel flow or switches to an existing one.

properties.name: restore
properties.brief: Restores the story from a state saved with `get_state`, by replaying it from the
properties.description:
Restores the story from a state saved with `get_state`, by replaying it from the
start, and returns its last paragraphs and choices. The story should be created
from the same, or a similar, JSON.
types: (state: StoryState, with_bindings?: boolean, ignore_errors?: boolean) => StoryOutput

properties.name: get_state
properties.brief: Returns the current state of the story, to save and pass to `restore` later.
properties.description: Returns the current state of the story, to save and pass to `restore` later.

properties.name: eval
properties.brief: Returns the result of evaluating a Lua expression, with the name of every global
properties.description:
Returns the result of evaluating a Lua expression, with the name of every global
variable replaced by its value.

properties.name: serialize
properties.brief: Returns the story's variables and visit counts, an alternative to `get_state`
properties.description:
Returns the story's variables and visit counts, an alternative to `get_state`
that survives script changes better. Pass it to `deserialize`, not to `restore`.

properties.name: deserialize
properties.brief: Restores the story's variables and visit counts from `serialize`, then jumps to a
properties.description:
Restores the story's variables and visit counts from `serialize`, then jumps to a
path and returns its paragraphs and choices.
types: (data: SerializedStory, path: string, reset_observers?: boolean) => StoryOutput
